description: Business Central on-premises: server instances (performance counters, process), telemetry events and operations, errors, database server, servers and the telemetry proxy. Data from bc-telemetry-proxy.
title: Business Central

widgets.description: Time for a single write to a system table; rising values point to SQL Server latency.
widgets.title: Heartbeat time

widgets.description: CPU seconds per second (1 = one fully used core).
widgets.title: BC server process CPU

filter.expression: deployment.environment IN $deployment.environment AND service.instance.id IN $instance AND severity_text IN ('ERROR', 'WARN', 'FATAL')
deployment.environment IN $deployment.environment AND service.instance.id IN $instance AND has_error = true
deployment.environment IN $deployment.environment AND service.instance.id IN $instance AND severity_text IN ('ERROR', 'FATAL')

widgets.description: First occurrence of each error fingerprint since the proxy started; report via /support/errors/<fingerprint>.

filter.expression: deployment.environment IN $deployment.environment AND service.instance.id IN $instance AND attribute.event.name = 'bc.error.first_seen'

widgets.title: New error kinds

widgets.description: RT0005 long running SQL, RT0012 lock timeout, RT0028 deadlock (enable EnableLockTimeoutMonitoring / EnableDeadlockMonitoring on the BC server).

filter.expression: deployment.environment IN $deployment.environment AND service.instance.id IN $instance AND bc.event.id IN ('RT0005', 'RT0012', 'RT0028')

widgets.title: Database waits seen by BC

widgets.description: 1 = the proxy can query the server; 0 = connection or permission problem.
widgets.title: SQL Server reachable

widgets.description: Seconds waited per second: lock = blocking, disk_io = storage, transaction_log = log writes, network_client = slow client (BC server).
widgets.title: Waits by category

widgets.description: Seconds a page stays in the buffer pool; falling values mean memory pressure.
widgets.title: Page life expectancy

widgets.description: Seconds of I/O stall per second; divide by sqlserver.database.operations for latency.
widgets.title: I/O wait per database

filter.expression: deployment.environment IN $deployment.environment AND service.name = 'sql-server' AND attribute.event.name IN ('sqlserver.blocking', 'sqlserver.deadlock')
deployment.environment IN $deployment.environment AND host.name IN $host AND system.memory.state = 'used'

widgets.description: Windows has no load average; processor queue plus busy cores, damped like Linux.
widgets.title: Load average (approximation)

widgets.description: 1 while the latest export to the backend failed.
widgets.title: Export degraded
